hook.name: PolymarketHook
hook.description: A prediction market hook that creates binary-outcome YES/NO token pairs backed by USDC. The `beforeSwap` handler intercepts trades on YES/USDC and NO/USDC pools: for buy orders it mints equal YES+NO tokens from USDC, performs an internal swap on the YES/NO pool to consolidate into the desired token, and returns the delta to settle the trade entirely within the hook.
